newsitem.title: USA: US Midcontinent unleaded, diesel prices strengthen - Feb 11.
newsitem.headline: US Midcontinent unleaded, diesel prices strengthen - Feb 11.

text.p: U.S. Group Three spot low sulfur diesel and gasoline strengthened Tuesday as refiner buying in the Gulf Coast trimmed midwestern supplies, traders said.
"There's buying on the Gulf Coast that's led to strength in the Group market,' one trader said, adding supplies continue to stay tight because of refinery problems and seasonal maintenance.
"Low sulphur diesel is moving higher," the trader said.
Buyers wanted to purchase prompt Group Three diesel at 4.50 cents over March heating oil, a 0.25 cent over earlier.
Chicago diesel was talked at the same premium over the screen.
Sellers priced Group Three conventional unleaded at 3.00 cents over March futures, up a quarter-cent from early ranges, while Chicago material was offered at parity to NYMEX, traders said.
March NYMEX heating oil settled 0.10 cents a gallon higher at 61.86 cents a gallon while NYMEX March gasoline edged up 0.43 cents a gallon to 63.96 cents.
